notes.title: Nomad Idle Public Playtest is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! [b]Nomad Idle[/b] is now playable in the Steam Playtest. It's playable up until Area 3!

If you have any feedback, I'm super open to it over on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/779FCkeeWT]Discord[/url].

Let me know if you have any trouble with this Playtest.

If you're coming from itch.io and would prefer to play this build on itch.io, you can! Check that out over here: https://thefoxknocks.itch.io/nomad-idle


In case you missed it in the previous post, I'm opting to do a Playtest because I want something playable on Steam, but doing a proper Demo at this time is just a bit too soon. I'll have more content available for the Demo as well. Expect that closer to NextFest in February.

Stay awesome!
